name: Google JSON API
description: Builds site search pages backed by Google's Programmable Search Engine JSON API, integrated with core Search.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 
 Google Programmable Search Engine allows the creation of custom search engines for a website. Integrating with the core Drupal search functionality, this module provides for the creation of search pages that use a JSON API to retrieve results from a Google custom search engine.

 
Support for both the Google Custom Search JSON API and the Google Custom Search Site Restricted JSON API is provided.

 Features 
 
 Integrates with Drupal core Search Pages. 
 Supports Google Custom Search and Site Restricted JSON APIs 
 Configurable search results page presentation and end-user messaging. 
 Modified pager to support Google 100 results limit and estimated results count. 
 
 Requirements 
 
A Google Custom Search Engine must be created and available. JSON API communication requires a Google API Key and a Custom Search Engine ID.

 Dependencies 
 Token Module
